Part B: 
```{r}
#B1
students <- data.frame(
  id = 1:8,
name = c("Alice", "Bruno", "Chen", "Dana", "Elif", "Farid", "Grace", "Hiro"),
sex = c("F", "M", "M", "F", "F", "M", "F", "M"),
section = c("A", "B", "A", "C", "B", "C", "A", "B"),
midterm = c(78, 85, 92, 67, 74, 88, 95, 59),
final = c(82, 79, 96, 71, 80, 91, 93, 65),
attendance = c(95, 88, 100, 72, 90, 85, 98, 60),
stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
```
```{r}
#B2
str(students)
dim(students)
colnames(students)
summary(students)
```
```{r}
#B3
students$average <- round(rowMeans(students[, c("midterm", "final")]), 1)
```
```{r}
#B4
students$passed <- students$average >= 70 & students$attendance >= 75
```
```{r}
#B5
students$standing <- ifelse(students$average >= 90, "Honors",
                      ifelse(students$average >= 75, "Good", "Needs Support"))
```
```{r}
#B6
classify <- function(score) {
  if (score >= 85) {
    return("Distinction")
  } else if (score >= 70) {
    return("Merit")
  } else if (score >= 50) {
    return("Pass")
  } else {
    return("Fail")
  }
}

sapply(c(90, 73, 55, 40), classify)

```
Part C: rbind() cbind()
```{r}
#C1
new_students <- data.frame(
id = c(9, 10),
name = c("Ines", "Jamal"),
sex = c("F", "M"),
section = c("C", "A"),
midterm = c(81, 70),
final = c(84, 68),
attendance = c(92, 80),
stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
new_students$average <- round(rowMeans(new_students[, c("midterm", "final")]), 1)
new_students$passed <- new_students$average >= 70 & new_students$attendance >= 75
new_students$standing <- ifelse(new_students$average >= 90, "Honors",
                   ifelse(new_students$average >= 75, "Good", "Needs Support"))

students_all <- rbind(students, new_students)
```
```{r}
#C2
quiz <- c(8, 7, 10, 6, 7, 9, 10, 5, 8, 6)
students_all <- cbind(students_all, quiz = quiz)
class(students_all)
```
```{r}
#C3
m <- cbind(midterm = students_all$midterm, final = students_all$final)
m <- rbind(m, mean = colMeans(m))
```
```{r}
#C4
tryCatch(
rbind(students, bad), 
error = function(e) { 
message("rbind failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
  NULL 
  }
)
```
Part D: Subsetting
```{r}
#D1
students_all$name
students_all[["name"]]
students_all[, "name"]
```
```{r}
#D2
students_all[2:5, c("name", "midterm", "final")]
```
```{r}
#D3
students_all[students_all$attendance > 90, ]
```
```{r}
#D4
subset(
  students_all, 
  sex == "F" & section %in% c("A", "C") & final >= 75, 
  select = c(name, section, final)
)
```
```{r}
#D5
students_all$name[which.max(students_all$average)]
students_all$name[which.min(students_all$average)]
```
```{r}
#D6
students_sorted <- students_all[order(-students_all$average), ]
head(students_sorted, 3)
```
